speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with a generalized rash; to help you, please tell me your exact age in hours or days. Are you having any difficulty breathing, feeding, or does the baby seem unusually lethargic or irritable? What does the rash look like on close inspection—does it blanch when pressed, is it scaly, or do you see any blisters?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Gonococcal neonatal sepsis (Neisseria gonorrhoeae conjunctivitis/skin infection).
